get.description: List all definitions, including disabled ones, for the roster editor.

patch.description: Apply a partial update; built-ins are editable but not deletable.

post.description: Copy a definition to another space's roster.

get.description: Newest alerts first, in one space or all of them, and how many are unseen.

post.description:
Resolve a pending call and release its agent.

Unknown IDs return 404; settled ones return 409 so another window sees
"already answered," not "gone."
Fetch the pinned App Server runtime; idempotent during download.

get.description: Return month-to-date spend and cap; ``space_id`` adds that space's share.

post.description: Start a scripted run that exercises events without a model.

get.description: Return liveness and the launch tag that identifies this sidecar.
List recent runs, newest first; ``origin`` filters UI, schedule, or Discord runs.

post.description:
Create a run and start its orchestrator.

Return after creating its row; clients follow it over SSE. The shared
:class:`~agentbase.orchestrator.launcher.RunLauncher` also serves channels.

delete.description:
Remove a finished run, events, and approvals; retain its spend.

Return 409 for unfinished runs so their orchestrator cannot lose its log.
Also refuse a locally driven run that just turned terminal: the
orchestrator releases it shortly after status write. See
:meth:`~agentbase.events.store.EventStore.delete_run` for retained data.

post.description:
Ask a run to stop.

202 means it stops at its next deadline check and writes `run.cancelled`,
so its returned row may remain `running`. Finished or nonlocal runs return 409.

get.description:
Stream one run as resumable SSE via `Last-Event-ID`.

``after_seq`` is the first-connection cursor; on reconnect, the further
header cursor wins.
Return the event log as an array for dashboard history, tests, and `curl`.

schema.title: Response Get Run Events Runs  Run Id  Events History Get

get.description: List every schedule or one space's schedules.

post.description:
Preview a cadence's wording and upcoming times before saving.

A stage that follows another schedule has no times of its own to show.

Start this schedule now without changing its next time.

It goes through the scheduler, so a run started by hand gets the
schedule's own time limit and the same guard against overlapping itself.

patch.description: Apply a partial settings update; validation failures return field-aware 400s.

get.description:
List selectable and priced models by provider.

Dropdowns use this instead of a list that could drift from ``pricing.py``.
With OpenAI through a ChatGPT subscription, each OpenAI model also says
whether the plan includes it, so a picker can keep to those.

post.description:
Check whether settings can build a provider without calling it.

This dashboard pre-flight shows a run's refusal before Start. ``space_id``
checks effective space settings.

get.description: List all spaces, including archived ones whose runs remain viewable.

post.description:
Create a space and seed its roster.

Seed after creating the row so a partial copy leaves a visible, repairable space.

delete.description: Delete an empty space and agents; return 409 for default or run-containing spaces.

get.description: Download a visible workbook from this space's folder.

put.description: Create or overwrite a text file; reject malformed JSON.

get.description: List note-adjacent plain-text configuration and agent-data files.

delete.description: Back up then delete a folder and its notes under `.agentbase/backups/`.

put.description: Turn the watch on or off by its file, writing the starter file the first time.

get.description:
Preview a provider switch: the space's mapped model and the agents it strands.

An agent that names the old provider, or a model while following the
space's provider, would ask the new provider for a model it does not
serve. Space settings lists these with their tier-mapped models and moves
the ones the person keeps ticked, through the ordinary agent update.

Report ledger calls by total, model, space, day, and costly run.

results to one space. Use the same rows as cap enforcement, so report and
meter agree.
